title: Video Import wizard (Import Video > embed to library)
description:
DONE. Implemented the Import Video wizard.

WHAT EXISTED: task 0760 added a SILENT File>Import>Import Video picker (useFileActions.importVideoToLibrary) that created a VideoItem with HARDCODED width=320/height=240/frameRate=12 and no UI feedback or codec/dimension surfacing. SWF emit (DefineVideoStream/VideoFrame, tasks 0757/1218), demuxFlv, VideoItem model, runMediaPass, and stage placement all pre-existed.

WHAT I IMPLEMENTED:
- packages/swf/src/video.ts: probeFlv() -> VideoProbe {codecId, codecName, width, height, frameCount, frameRate}; videoCodecName(); scanFlvMetaNumber() reads onMetaData framerate. Exported from index.ts.
- packages/authoring-ui/src/VideoImportDialog.tsx: NEW wizard surfacing codec/dimensions/frame count/frame rate, editable name/width/height/fps, embed-target radio (Library only | Library + place on Stage). Pure buildVideoItem() helper.
- useFileActions: importVideoToLibrary -> probeVideoFile() (returns PendingVideoImport, no longer hardcodes dims).
- useLibraryHandlers: handleImportVideo opens wizard; handleVideoImportConfirm creates VideoItem (real probed dims) + optionally places centered VideoDisplayObject; handleVideoImportCancel.
- uiStore: PendingVideoImport type + videoImportPending state/setter.
- ShellDialogs renders VideoImportDialog; Shell wires confirm/cancel + withTimeline dep.
- MenuBar File>Import>Import Video... already wired (pre-existing onImportVideo).

TESTS (added): packages/swf/src/__tests__/videoprobe.test.ts (5 tests), packages/authoring-ui/src/__tests__/videoImportDialog.test.ts (6 tests).

VERIFICATION:
- pnpm --filter './packages/**' build: all 7 packages Done (typecheck green).
- @flash/swf: 110 files, 1378 passed | 1 todo (includes new videoprobe).
- @flash/authoring-ui: 43 files, 645 passed (includes new videoImportDialog).
- @flash/core: 330 passed, 3 failed = ONLY the documented missing fixtures/flash8-empty.fla (task 1207); no new failures.

SCOPE OUT (deferred, per task): live FLV streaming, cue-point editor, skin picker. Docs/11-video.md updated.
